projects.description: Live cloud-native Learning Management System (LMS) platform built on AWS with zero-downtime deployments, multi-tenant architecture, and production-grade infrastructure as code.

projects.name: CloudShield-Federated
projects.description: CloudShield-Federated is a production-grade, hybrid federated learning MLOps platform built for secure financial fraud detection. It implements a split-architecture monorepo that separates decentralized edge training from a secure cloud-native Kubernetes control plane. The system leverages Flower 1.36 for distributed model aggregation, MLflow for experiment tracking and model registry, Envoy Gateway for secure TLS termination and backend re-encryption, and a centralized FastAPI service to serve real-time predictions using global model checkpoints.
